hosts.statement: Every path on vantage.insta.host, including the SPA client routes, content-hashed static assets, the health endpoint and the public Trust Center API, is fronted by Cloudflare Access and answers 302 to the identity provider until the visitor authenticates. No content is served anonymously.

authorities.observed_result: CNAME vantage.insta.host -> 40cd9ce8-5c37-4b72-afe4-698c57cd8b65.cfargotunnel.com, proxied=true, created by this release

172.67.159.176, 104.21.14.146 - Cloudflare proxy addresses only. The origin 192.168.100.116 is never published, and every path requires Access authentication before the origin is reached, so the name resolves publicly while the service remains gated.
172.67.159.176, 104.21.14.146 - agrees with 1.1.1.1, so public resolvers have converged
172.67.159.176, 104.21.14.146 - agrees with the other public resolvers
172.67.159.176, 104.21.14.146 - no stale negative cache on the operator client

authorities.resolver: none - the estate publishes no private zone for insta.host
authorities.observed_result: No private authority can answer for this name; nas1 reaches the service on its own loopback and no split-horizon record exists

authorities.resolver: docker embedded DNS on network ix-vantage_default
authorities.observed_result: Resolves only the compose service name 'vantage' inside the bridge network 172.16.41.0/24; it cannot and does not answer for vantage.insta.host

authorities.resolver: none - no Active Directory zone serves insta.host
authorities.observed_result: Not applicable to this estate; no directory resolver can answer for the name

certificate.source: Cloudflare universal certificate, issued by Google Trust Services CN=WE1
certificate.verify_result: SSL certificate verify ok; curl reports host vantage.insta.host matched the certificate's *.insta.host
certificate.note: vantage.insta.host adds exactly one label to insta.host, so it falls inside the single-label scope of the wildcard.

probes.note: The Trust Center client route is gated like every other path
Nested content-hashed asset does not fall through to another origin; it is gated
Even the application's own anonymous endpoint is gated at the edge
Protected API gated at the edge before the application sees it
Health is gated publicly, which is why monitoring is pointed at the origin instead

probes.observed_origin: books.insta.host origin via the same tunnel
probes.note: A different estate service outside the vantage namespace answers 200 through the same edge and the same DNS authority, proving the 302 observed on every vantage path is this application's Access policy rather than a blanket edge or DNS behaviour.

artifacts.name: SPA application bundle
artifacts.cache_justification: Vite emits content-hashed filenames referenced from index.html, so every asset URL changes when the bytes change and no purge is required. Assets under /assets/ are served immutable and index.html with a short max-age.
